A day for each feast

Dia de los Angelitos

A Day of Loving Remembrance for Dia de los Angelitos

On November 1st, we lovingly prepare our homes to welcome back the spirits of children who have passed, believing they return first to feel the warmth of their families.

  1. Morning

    Preparing the Altar for Angelitos

    Begin the day by lovingly setting up your altar. Adorn it with bright candles, cherished toys, and colourful paper cut-outs, creating a welcoming beacon for the little spirits.

  2. Late Morning

    Crafting Sweet Tributes

    Dedicate time to prepare traditional treats. Bake tiny pan de muerto loaves, craft intricate sugar skulls, and gather other favourite sweets that delighted the children in life.

    Recipes: Pan de Muerto · Sugar Skulls (Calaveras de Azúcar) · Nan-e Berenji (Persian Rice Cookies)

  3. Early Afternoon

    Arranging the Angelitos' Feast

    Carefully arrange the prepared foods, along with fresh fruit, on the altar. These offerings are a loving invitation for the angelitos to enjoy the flavours of home.

    Recipes: Seasonal Fruit Offering Platter

  4. Late Afternoon

    Guiding Lights and Sounds

    As the afternoon progresses, scatter vibrant marigold petals from your door to the altar, creating a fragrant path. Gently ring bells to announce your readiness to welcome the returning spirits.

  5. Evening

    Sharing Warmth and Memories

    As dusk settles, prepare a warm batch of atole. This comforting beverage can be offered on the altar and shared among family members, symbolizing warmth and continued connection.

    Recipes: Traditional Atole de Maiz

  6. Night

    Quiet Reflection and Presence

    Spend a quiet moment by the glowing altar. Reflect on the joyful memories of the children being honoured, feeling their presence close as they visit their earthly home.

May your home be filled with love and cherished memories as you honour your angelitos.

Feast-day recipes

  • Traditional Atole de Maiz
  • Sugar Skulls (Calaveras de Azúcar)
  • Pan de Muerto
  • Seasonal Fruit Offering Platter
